intro.en: Use short everyday texts to find a time, a price, a place or a simple instruction.

texto.en: A short notice often gives one main piece of information: a time, place, price or rule. Read the heading and numbers first, then check the words around them. You do not need to understand every word to find a departure time or choose an item from a menu.

frases.es: Abierto de lunes a sábado, de 9:00 a 18:00. Cerrado los domingos.
frases.en: Open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00. Closed on Sundays.

frases.es: Menú del día: sopa, tortilla o ensalada. Agua incluida. Precio: 12 euros.
frases.en: Set menu: soup, Spanish omelette or salad. Water included. Price: 12 euros.

frases.es: Hola, llego a las seis. Te espero delante del museo.
frases.en: Hi, I arrive at six. I will wait for you in front of the museum.
